info.name: Fetch the latest list of assets connected to AIES.

params.name: asset_ID
params.description: This parameter can contain up to 20 comma-separated Asset IDs.

params.name: pool_participant_ID
params.description: This parameter can contain up to 20 comma-separated Pool Participant IDs.

params.name: operating_status
params.description: The allowed values are ACTIVE, RETIRED, SUSPENDED, INACTIVE

params.name: asset_type
params.description: The allowed values are SOURCE, SINK

items.docs:
The asset_ID and pool_participant_ID parameters are comma separated lists. At most, one of the two parameters can be passed in an API call.

Note: The Operating Status, Pool Participant Name and ID for an asset can change overtime.
